name: @intellectual-frontiers/change-control
description: Change control for a fleet's repository: each change is accepted only if a signer of the fleet signed it, a change to a controlled path is blocked until a different signer of an approving role approves it, and what is refused or blocked is said with the reason; the signers are the fleet's own and the check reads Git with its own signature verification.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
